policy.scope: Other DCAI attribution and duration diagnostics. Not a new preferred forecast, management guidance, or unsupported upside. Outputs not calculated before freezing these rules.
policy.source_claim: Management purpose-built silicon tripled in past three years and is positioned to triple in next few years. Other DCAI is a broader disclosed bucket. Neither exact base period nor a2030 total-bucket forecast is supplied.

whole_other_tripling_2030.2027: Keep base Other revenue and all CPU/client paths.
whole_other_tripling_2030.2028_2030: Multiply each base annual Other growth factor by (3/3.36)^(1/3), so2030 Other equals3x2026E5.19B. This retains selected2027front-loading;3x is only a literal broad-bucket diagnostic, not management total-bucket guidance.
whole_other_tripling_2030.2031_on: Keep base Other annual growth rates on revised2030level.

other_growth_normalizes_2031.2031_on: Other DCAI revenue grows3% annually from base2030level. No further extraordinary broad-bucket growth after the management claim horizon. This does not assert competition eliminates custom demand.

policy.operating_delta: Apply20%of changed Other sales as the total consolidated EBIT delta. This is an owned marginal-profit diagnostic, not a disclosed standalone Other margin. Assign the delta to DCAI solely to reconcile aggregation; do not also change Foundry profit, reverse transfers, or credit wafer savings.20%includes recurring product/platform costs and existing manufacturing transfer convention.
policy.margin_uncertainty: Also report10%and30%retention unit sensitivities under exactly the same revenue/capital paths, without choosing a preferred result. These are not probability cases or independent forecasts.
policy.funding_2027_2030: Hold all physical capex, D&A, leases, NCI and fixed treasury policy. Adjust host WC cash use by10%of annual change in Other revenue delta; lower sales balances are avoided, not an inventory disposal or sale of stranded factory assets. Tax recalculates. A positive required-minimum-cash check must pass.
policy.funding_2031_on: Host net operating investment equals revised host annual sales change/0.8. WC equals10%of revised sales change. Gross capex equals unchanged base consolidated D&A plus revised net investment minus revised WC. Keeping base D&A explicitly retains depreciation of previously installed assets; lower growth reduces future additions without receiving a one-off asset-sale windfall. This is a normalized maintenance/growth convention, not a tool-vintage proof. External packaging overlay stays unchanged and separately funded at1.0.
policy.tax_and_claims: Same tax rates, old/new credits and paired basis losses, ordinary debt/interest, cash income, leases, minority reserve,5.51Bclaims and11.555%risk. Check early credit eligible-basis does not exceed remaining physical capex; financing shield cannot exceed positive operating tax.
policy.terminal: All2041cash lines must grow3%versus2040. At normalized3%Other growth this condition should hold. No discount-rate compression or external-wafer award.
policy.interpretation: The mix identity f*3+(1-f)*1.03^4 cannot reach3.36 for any f in[0,1]. That exposes the logical insufficiency of the narrower triple claim to establish broad-bucket3.36x, but does not disprove the owned forecast because timing, starting population and growth of residual businesses are not disclosed.

mixture_identity.interpretation: A fraction above100% demonstrates that narrower3x cannot alone establish broader3.36x under these illustrative timing and residual-growth assumptions. Those assumptions are not disclosures.
